sql.customFieldSql.brs.ahjList: select a.id, a.name from brs.ahj a where archived is not true order by a.name
sql.customFieldSql.brs.utilityCompanyList: select a.id, a.name from brs.ahj_utility a where archived is not true order by a.name
sql.customFieldSql.brs.proposalLogNumbers: select plh.id, plh.proposal_nbr as name from brs.proposal_log_history plh where plh.project_id = :projectId order by plh.proposal_nbr
